question: Average surface temperature per year per region
expected_sql: SELECT date_trunc('year', p.obs_time) AS yr, p.region, avg(m.temperature_c) FROM measurements m JOIN profiles p ON p.profile_id = m.profile_id WHERE m.pressure_dbar < 10 AND m.qc_flag = 1 AND m.temperature_c IS NOT NULL GROUP BY yr, p.region ORDER BY yr, p.region

question: Number of profiles per year
expected_sql: SELECT date_trunc('year', obs_time) AS yr, count(*) FROM profiles GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr

question: Average surface temperature for each month of the year averaged across all years
expected_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM p.obs_time) AS mth, avg(m.temperature_c) FROM measurements m JOIN profiles p ON p.profile_id = m.profile_id WHERE m.pressure_dbar < 10 AND m.qc_flag = 1 AND m.temperature_c IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mth ORDER BY mth

question: Year over year change in mean surface temperature
expected_sql: WITH yearly AS (SELECT date_trunc('year', p.obs_time) AS yr, avg(m.temperature_c) AS t FROM measurements m JOIN profiles p ON p.profile_id = m.profile_id WHERE m.pressure_dbar < 10 AND m.qc_flag = 1 AND m.temperature_c IS NOT NULL GROUP BY yr) SELECT yr, t - lag(t) OVER (ORDER BY yr) AS change FROM yearly ORDER BY yr

question: Which region warmed the most from its first to its last year?
expected_sql: WITH yearly AS (SELECT p.region, date_trunc('year', p.obs_time) AS yr, avg(m.temperature_c) AS t FROM measurements m JOIN profiles p ON p.profile_id = m.profile_id WHERE m.pressure_dbar < 10 AND m.qc_flag = 1 AND m.temperature_c IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.region, yr), ends AS (SELECT region, first_value(t) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY yr) AS first_t, last_value(t) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY yr ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_t FROM yearly) SELECT region FROM ends GROUP BY region ORDER BY max(last_t - first_t) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Median salinity per region
expected_sql: SELECT p.region, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m.salinity_psu) FROM measurements m JOIN profiles p ON p.profile_id = m.profile_id WHERE m.qc_flag = 1 AND m.salinity_psu IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.region ORDER BY p.region

question: Profiles per year with a running cumulative total
expected_sql: SELECT date_trunc('year', obs_time) AS yr, count(*) AS n, sum(count(*)) OVER (ORDER BY date_trunc('year', obs_time)) AS cumulative FROM profiles GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr

question: Rank the regions by mean surface temperature
expected_sql: SELECT p.region, rank() OVER (ORDER BY avg(m.temperature_c) DESC) AS rnk FROM measurements m JOIN profiles p ON p.profile_id = m.profile_id WHERE m.pressure_dbar < 10 AND m.qc_flag = 1 AND m.temperature_c IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.region ORDER BY rnk

question: What is the warmest calendar month in each region?
expected_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT p.region, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM p.obs_time) AS mth, avg(m.temperature_c) AS t FROM measurements m JOIN profiles p ON p.profile_id = m.profile_id WHERE m.pressure_dbar < 10 AND m.qc_flag = 1 AND m.temperature_c IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.region, mth), ranked AS (SELECT region, mth, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY t DESC) AS rn FROM monthly) SELECT region, mth FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY region
